query:
SELECT
            d.day::date AS "day!",
            COALESCE(SUM(wi.story_points), 0) AS "done_on_day!: i64"
        FROM generate_series($1::date, $2::date, '1 day'::interval) AS d(day)
        LEFT JOIN work_items wi
            ON wi.sprint_id = $3
            AND wi.status::text = 'done'
            AND wi.completed_at::date = d.day::date
        GROUP BY d.day
        ORDER BY d.day ASC
